name: Roomory
summary:
Roomory is a local mixed reality experience for creating a memory room or surprise room for someone special.

It is made for the person who knows VR and wants to prepare something meaningful for someone who may be new to it. Set up a real room with photos, videos, audio, and small surprise moments, arrange them with Quest controllers, then hand the headset to someone you care about.

They do not need to build anything. They can simply walk through the room, discover what you placed, replay meaningful media,
